title: lei-commons country snapshot
description: Where to get every legal entity lei-commons holds for one country: the files of the latest full snapshot, each with a permanent content-addressed URL, its SHA-256, size, record count and Merkle root, and how to bring them up to the current day. A superset of the DeDi Public-Data-Set schema: every record also validates against it (data_url is the full snapshot's manifest, which lists every file and is signed with Sigstore).

type.description: Public-Data-Set: data_url points at the full snapshot's manifest (JSON); the data itself is Parquet (see parts).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; XX for records whose country is unknown.

format.description: The files' format and schema, e.g. parquet; the columns are documented at schema_url.

schema_url.description: Where the Parquet columns are documented.

date.description: The full snapshot these files belong to.

snapshot_root.description: Merkle root of that day's whole directory; signed in the manifest.

signature_url.description: The manifest's Sigstore bundle (Rekor transparency log).

records.description: This country's records in that full snapshot.

parts.description: This country's files in the full snapshot. Records are split by their exact sources (e.g. register only, or register and GLEIF) and, for large groups, by shard.

url.description: Permanent: the address is the SHA-256 of the bytes, so it never changes meaning.

root.description: Merkle root of the file's rows; anyone can recompute it.

current.description: The latest day. Between full snapshots only changes are published; recipe_url lists the change files to apply to the parts above (each change row carries its country).

sources.description: The sources this country's records come from, with the credit each licence asks for.
